claimedSlice: opencv2/cudaoptflow.hpp parser-backed CUDA optical-flow public declarations plus the pinned module CMake build/dependency contract
limitation: The map records parser identities and exact CudaOptFlow wrapper evidence; it does not claim repository-wide contrib parity or external module availability.
externalDataDependencies: The cudaoptflow module is disabled unless the OpenCV build enables CUDA or CUDA stubs and is unavailable on iOS/WinRT; real optical-flow execution depends on an external CUDA toolkit/runtime.

The module requires opencv_video, opencv_optflow, opencv_cudaarithm, opencv_cudawarping, opencv_cudaimgproc, and opencv_cudafeatures2d, with optional opencv_cudalegacy; CUDA >= 10 may download NVIDIA Optical Flow SDK 2.0 headers. GpuMat/Stream, asynchronous flow transport, algorithm state, and SDK provenance remain outside this package; no CUDA optical-flow wrapper/runtime is bundled.

declarations.reason: Enum and class declarations are retained as parser metadata; callable evidence is classified independently.

The CUDA optical-flow surface in cv::cuda has no native CudaOptFlow wrapper entrypoint or managed public owner in the current package; OpenCV disables the module on iOS/WinRT and unless CUDA or CUDA stubs are enabled, while real dense/sparse optical-flow execution requires an external CUDA toolkit/runtime and the optional NVIDIA Optical Flow SDK. GpuMat/Stream ownership, asynchronous execution, flow-field transport, and algorithm state remain outside the current ABI/API and deterministic smoke contract.
Enum and class declarations are retained as parser metadata; callable evidence is classified independently.
